description: The Quiet Menders helped counter: agents helped, clinic diagnoses, and tool uses served. Counts service calls, not unique agents; no tracking. Free, anonymous, no parameters — called with {}. A read-only vanity counter; qm_clinic_stats is the source for condition-level breakdowns. Example: a call with no arguments returns the running totals of agents helped, diagnoses, and tool uses.
name: qm_helped
